author: rolexl
body:
# experiment: add absolute-return prediction diagnostics and feature rebuilds

## PR概述

本PR提交一条与横截面排序研究完全隔离的绝对收益预测路线，汇总并实现从直接绝对收益基准、训练与数据诊断、
市场共同收益与个股残差分解，到指数市场状态和双支路Feature重构的完整研究闭环。

研究目标是预测每只股票未来若干分钟的绝对毛收益，而不是直接优化同一时点的股票排序。Rank IC、AUC、ACC和
分位数组合收益只作为诊断指标；相对排序有效不等于绝对收益幅度或方向有效，也不能直接解释为交易信号。

本PR保留成功和失败证据。当前最重要的结论是：Label、PIT、优化器、模型拟合能力和稳定泄漏均未发现足以解释
失败的明显问题；指数能够很好地代表PIT池未来共同收益，但signal-time已知的现货、ETF和行业状态信息仍不能
稳定预测未来共同收益。个股残差模型存在横截面排序信息，但绝对残差幅度仍未胜过zero或Ridge。因此市场支路
和残差支路均未通过，未执行两支路重组，也不声称获得可用的绝对收益模型。

## 冻结研究问题

最终产品量保持为未来绝对毛收益：

```text
R_stock(t, h)
```

后续诊断将其拆成：

```text
R_stock(t, h)
= R_market(t, h)
+ R_residual(t, h)
```

其中：

- `R_market`为同一signal time合法PIT池未来收益的共同成分；
- `R_residual`为个股未来收益减去该共同成分；
- 两个支路分别训练、分别过门；
- 只有两个支路都通过预注册门禁后，才允许相加恢复绝对收益。

本轮两个支路均未通过，所以没有执行最终相加。

## 数据与时间安全协议

### PIT股票池

- 范围：沪深主板；
- 换手率字段：自由流通换手率；
- 计算方式：严格T-1、过去60个完整交易日算术平均；
- 最少有效观测：50个交易日；
- 主股票池区间：闭区间5%–15%；
- 股票池身份按交易日更新；
- 慢变量严格滞后一整个完整交易日；
- 分钟`t`的输入只允许使用`t`及以前可见的信息；
- 不采用随机时间切分。

### 最新市场与残差支路时间切分

| 用途 | 时间范围 |
|:--|:--|
| Train | 2025-07-01至2025-11-03 |
| Valid-select | 2025-11-03至2025-12-01 |
| Calibration | 2025-12-01至2026-01-05 |
| January Evaluation | 2026-01-05至2026-02-02 |

所有segment均独立执行label maturity检查，要求signal time和对应horizon的exit time同时位于该segment内。
旧的rolling-origin实验未执行split-local maturity，因此其模型数值已被明确标记为失效；原始指数源与分钟轴审计
仍可作为数据证据保留。

本次代码提交与测试没有触发新的市场数据读取。最新指数校准、市场Feature和残差Feature实验均未读取2026年4月
及以后数据；PR中保留的早期冻结回放报告仅作为历史证据，不授权重新读取保留期、refit、策略、回测、仓位、
订单或交易。

## 一、直接绝对收益基准与诊断闭环

基础模型使用共享PatchTST backbone和`5/15/30/60/120/240/480`分钟七个收益头。主要对照包括：

- zero prediction；
- Train mean和median；
- 5分钟momentum和reversal；
- Train-only streaming Ridge；
- RMSE skill、RMSE、MAE、ACC、BAcc、MCC、AUC；
- Pearson、Rank IC、分位数spread；
- 逐交易日指标和交易日block bootstrap。

依次进行的有界诊断包括：

| 实验 | 单变量改动 | 结论 |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `absolute_return_step_curve_v1` | step级验证和checkpoint | 更细checkpoint能找到较好训练点，但不能修复目标泛化 |
| `absolute_return_grouped_clocks_v1` | `5–60/120/240–480`分组训练时钟 | 修复不同horizon学习速度问题，但跨月绝对收益仍失败 |
| `absolute_return_pit_10_15_v1` | 股票池缩小到10%–15%换手率 | 未胜过同口径5%–15%人口 |
| `absolute_return_source_semantics_v2` | 修复状态与开盘集合竞价语义 | 指标近似持平，原始行情语义不是首要根因 |
| `absolute_return_mse_v1` | MSE替换Huber | RMSE略改善，但zero skill仍约为零或负，方向和排序退化 |
| `absolute_return_diagnostic_v1` | 每250 step逐头与分组日志 | 补齐诊断后仍未通过基线门 |

这些实验共同说明，继续调整epoch、checkpoint粒度、普通正则或同一OHLCVA信息的训练方式，缺乏足够证据。

## 二、Sanity Check

本路线完成了以下实现正确性检查：

1. 原始分钟Bar独立复算Label；
2. 固定小样本、关闭dropout后的过拟合测试；
3. shuffled-label多seed随机对照；
4. initialization-only配对；
5. 交易日moving-block bootstrap；
6. Train/Valid特征缺失率、median/IQR与标签比例漂移；
7. 日期、分钟位置、行业、换手率和市值分组；
8. 完整lookback内部位置缺失率；
9. 8卡checkpoint resume一致性。

关键结果：

- 原始Bar Label抽查105/105条float32 bit-exact，最大误差为0；
- 固定512条样本、dropout=0后，Huber由`0.585392`下降到`9.09e-05`，下降约99.98%；
- 首轮3-seed shuffled-label按严格逐seed规则为19/21通过；
- 后续10-seed initialization-only配对和交易日block bootstrap没有发现跨seed、跨日期块可重复的泄漏方向；
- 最终泄漏诊断为`PASS_NO_REPEATABLE_SHUFFLED_LABEL_LEAKAGE_PATTERN`。

这些结果只能排除明显实现错误和稳定泄漏，不能证明正式模型具有泛化能力。

## 三、市场共同收益与个股残差分解

`absolute_return_market_residual_v1`首次实现：

```text
Market common return + Stock residual = Absolute gross return
```

初版发现，为匹配股票loader，一个股票epoch内Market loader被重复permutation约1210次。随后
`absolute_return_market_residual_multirate_v1`引入独立训练时钟，修复Market数据过度循环，并改善中长周期误差。
但冻结时间外评测中，最终绝对收益仍未稳定胜过zero，个股残差排序也发生跨月翻转。

因此该实验只证明分解恒等式、数据对齐和独立训练时钟可实现，不证明两个分支已经可预测。

## 四、指数市场状态与Target对齐

### Target alignment诊断

使用未来五个宽基指数收益进行不可部署的事后对齐诊断：

| Horizon | 指数未来收益与PIT共同收益Pearson | RMSE skill | 结论 |
|--:|--:|--:|:--|
| 240m | 0.9181 | +49.67% | PASS |
| 480m | 0.9018 | +45.83% | PASS |

这证明五指数可以代表PIT池共同收益，排除了主要target/proxy mismatch；但未来指数收益不属于signal-time输入，
不能把该结果解释为可预测性。

### Signal-time指数模型

修复split-local maturity后，模型使用31项signal-time市场通道，训练240/480分钟收益头和上涨概率头：

```text
Loss = equal-head standardized Huber + 0.1 × BCE
```

| H | Raw Pearson | Raw RMSE skill | Calibrated RMSE skill | Probability AUC | Probability BAcc |
|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| 240m | +0.1461 | +0.088% | −2.771% | 66.27% | 50.00% |
| 480m | +0.1949 | +0.057% | −4.767% | 43.65% | 47.81% |

Valid-select、Calibration与January Evaluation之间的score→return映射发生翻转，两个horizon的交易日block
bootstrap下界也均未超过0。正式状态为：

```text
FAIL_INDEX_CALIBRATED_240_480_GATE
```

## 五、市场Feature重构

在相同target、时间切分、seed、PatchTST容量、优化器和门禁下，配对比较：

- `control31`：原31项PIT池和五指数市场输入；
- `etf46`：增加510050、510300、510500的15项简单分钟输入；
- `enhanced54`：再增加8项按有效行业去重后的行业状态中位数/IQR。

固定模型参数：

- 240/480分钟；
- 1200分钟lookback；
- patch length 30、stride 15；
- `d_model=32`、1层、2个attention heads、FFN 64；
- dropout 0.1；
- 8 GPU BF16、global batch 512；
- AdamW，学习率`3e-4`、weight decay `1e-2`；
- Loss为等权标准化Huber加`0.1 × BCE`；
- checkpoint只按固定Valid-select收益Huber选择。

January关键结果：

| Variant | H | Raw RMSE skill | Raw Pearson | Raw BAcc | Calibrated skill |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| control31 | 240 | +0.080% | 0.1436 | 49.73% | −2.77% |
| control31 | 480 | +0.050% | 0.1926 | 50.00% | −4.74% |
| etf46 | 240 | −0.28% | 0.0458 | 53.49% | −2.82% |
| etf46 | 480 | −0.22% | −0.0215 | 50.00% | −3.86% |
| enhanced54 | 240 | +0.25% | 0.1694 | 55.18% | −2.77% |
| enhanced54 | 480 | −4.73% | 0.2168 | 50.00% | −3.98% |

ETF-only没有改善配对控制组；ETF加行业状态只改善240分钟raw层面的局部状态/排序信息，480分钟幅度预测和
跨期Calibration仍失败。正式状态为：

```text
FAIL_MARKET_FEATURE_REBUILD_GATE
```

## 六、个股残差Feature重构

残差模型独立预测：

```text
个股未来绝对收益 − 同时点PIT池未来共同收益
```

输入包括：

- 12项个股/行业分钟特征；
- 5项严格T-1慢变量；
- 有效日期行业embedding；
- 54项signal-time市场条件序列；
- stock/market双PatchTST encoder后late fusion。

训练参数：

- Train `4,705,824`条；
- 完整Valid-select `1,310,112`条，固定选择样本`100,000`条；
- January Evaluation `1,034,064`条；
- 240/480分钟，1200分钟lookback；
- 模型参数`754,690`；
- 8 GPU BF16、global batch 512；
- AdamW学习率`3e-4`、weight decay `1e-2`；
- 等权标准化Huber；
- 最佳checkpoint为step 1500。

| H | RMSE skill vs no-info | Skill vs Ridge | BAcc | Pearson | Daily Rank IC |
|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| 240m | −0.648% | −0.280% | 50.79% | 0.0525 | 0.0789 |
| 480m | −0.887% | −0.511% | 49.99% | 0.0483 | 0.0780 |

残差模型学到了“同一时点哪些股票相对更强”的排序信息，但没有学到稳定的绝对残差幅度或双向方向。正式状态为：

```text
FAIL_RESIDUAL_GATE
```

由于市场支路也失败，本轮没有执行：

```text
market prediction + residual prediction
```

## 训练产物规则

正式训练生成但不全部进入Git的产物包括：

- `loss_curve.json`；
- 综合与逐horizon Train/Valid loss曲线；
- best/latest checkpoint；
- Train-only scaler；
- 完整预测与逐日/分组指标；
- baseline和bootstrap结果；
- 机器可读manifest及SHA-256边车。

本PR只提交实现、配置、合同、测试、报告和少量代表性曲线，不提交：

- 原始或派生市场数据；
- Qlib bin和Feature overlay；
- checkpoint与optimizer state；
- 完整预测；
- 大型CSV、Parquet、Numpy文件或artifact运行目录。

## 推荐代码阅读顺序

1. `docs/absolute_return/README.md`：路线与实验继承关系；
2. `docs/absolute_return/FEATURE_BRANCH_RESULT_20260822.md`：最新双支路合同和结果；
3. `absolute_return_direct_v1`与`absolute_return_continuous_v1`：基础Dataset、模型和诊断；
4. `absolute_return_index_target_alignment_v1`：target/proxy对齐；
5. `absolute_return_index_calibrated_240_480_v1`：修正maturity后的市场门；
6. `absolute_return_market_feature_rebuild_v1`：市场Feature配对实验；
7. `absolute_return_residual_feature_rebuild_v1`：个股残差实验。

## 测试与提交检查

执行：

```bash
.venv/bin/pytest -q \
  tests/absolute_return_direct_v1 \
  tests/absolute_return_continuous_v1 \
  tests/absolute_return_step_curve_v1 \
  tests/absolute_return_grouped_clocks_v1 \
  tests/absolute_return_market_residual_v1 \
  tests/absolute_return_market_residual_multirate_v1 \
  tests/absolute_return_market_state_v1 \
  tests/absolute_return_index_market_state_v1 \
  tests/absolute_return_index_target_alignment_v1 \
  tests/absolute_return_index_calibrated_240_480_v1 \
  tests/absolute_return_market_residual_feature_rebuild_v1
```

结果：

```text
146 passed, 1 warning in 25.96s
```

唯一warning来自Pandas对空或全NA DataFrame拼接行为的未来兼容提示，不影响当前测试结论。

## 综合结论

1. 当前失败不能简单归因于明显Label错误、模型无法优化或稳定数据泄漏；
2. checkpoint粒度、分组时钟、PIT缩池、source semantics与Huber/MSE均不是决定性根因；
3. 五个宽基指数未来收

author: reddimus
body:
Follow-up to #240, found by deploying the merged build and looking at it.

At a window narrow enough for the two-row search bar, the controls still
rendered:

```
‹ Prev   Next ›   Wrap: On   Case: Smart ›  Enter: Next No match
```

`Enter: Next` fills its slot exactly, so one column between it and the status
does not read as a boundary — control and outcome run together as a single
phrase. #240 added group spacing to the wide branch only; the narrow packer kept
single gaps and reproduced the problem it was meant to fix.

The narrow rows now use the same rule: one column between siblings, two where a
group ends. A group boundary never costs a control its place on the row — the
wrap check runs against the column before the gap is applied, so the wider gap
collapses back to one when it would push the next control past the edge.

The new guard walks six window widths across both layouts. Without the grouping
it fails with exactly the string the deployed app showed:

```
control abuts status at width=820 rows=2:
  ‹ Prev   Next ›   Wrap: On   Case: Smart ›  Enter: Next No match
```

Worth noting how this was caught: #240's unit tests were green, and its
screenshot check happened to use a window wide enough for the one-row layout.
Only running the deployed binary at a smaller size showed it.

author: veho-domi
body:
## Was drin ist

**1 · Das Ring-Tor hatte nur Obergrenzen — jetzt hat es acht gemessene Gesetze.**
Vor dem ersten Handgriff gegen alle vier zurückgewiesenen Lieferungen gefahren: **viermal Exit 0**. Eine gespiegelte Naht liefert Fuge 0,000, also die Bestnote, die dieses Tor kannte. Neu, je Naht (Bühne a\|b · Bühne Wrap · Band-Schleife): Profil-Flachheit · Spaltenprobe je Kanal · Streuung an k = 0; an den Zylinder-Schlüssen zusätzlich Adjazenz-Konsistenz · Vorzeichen-Gesetz · Anteil kleiner Differenzen · Anteil kanal-uniformer Zeilen. Dazu Sperr-SHAs der vier messbaren zurückgewiesenen Bühnen.

Fünf Läufe im Report-Ordner, je mit Urteilszeile pro Blatt:
`c3 Bühne ROT · c4 Bühne ROT / Band GRÜN · c5 Bühne ROT / Band GRÜN · c6 Bühne ROT / Band GRÜN`
Zwei Tamper im Selbsttest, beide auf dem Fall, wo richtig und plausibel-falsch auseinandergehen: die c5-Masche besteht (ii)–(iv), die c6-Masche besteht zusätzlich (v)+(vi).

**2 · Zwei Tafel-Tore haben das Falsche gemessen** (P-80). Die Schiefer-Helligkeit lief auf kreide-gefilterten Pixeln — genau der Filter, durch den AQ13b2 kam; der Selbsttest zeigt beide Zahlen in einem Satz (`voll 61,35 · gefiltert 9,00`). Die Massenfarb-Regel bekommt eine Ausnahme per gepinntem **Zell-SHA** (nie per Name); die Pin-Liste ist leer bis zum B4-Wareneingang.

**3 · Das Band von AQ13c4 ist importiert** — ein Blatt, ein bestehender Stem, **DEAD_ART 53 → 53**. Rauhheit nach der Nachverdichtung neu gemessen: **0,29924**, Zeichen für Zeichen dieselbe, Reserve 0,00076 unangetastet.

**4 · Der Boss hat eine Lebensanzeige** (R193b). `getState` reicht `knotsTotal` und `wipeTeil` heraus (deklariert, Muster S2); der Chip zeigt ein Kästchen je Schicht, das oberste läuft leer beim Wischen.

---

## ⚠ Zwei Fragen an dich, Koki — beide Geschmack, beide mit Bild

**(a) Das Band: Publikumsband oder leere Stühle?** Ein blinder Prüfer hat gefunden, was keine meiner Zahlen gesehen hat: das neue Blatt ist eine **durchgehende Masse**, der Bestand sind **einzelne Stühle**. Zeilendeckung je 48 Zeilen — Bestand `384 · 1284 · 1194 · 953 · 234` gegen neu `85 · 2048 · 2048 · 2048 · 1493`. Ursache: AQ13c4 hat ein RING-Band bestellt (durchlaufend um eine runde Bühne), und das Tor belohnt genau das; der Stem, den es ersetzt, ist die Klassenzimmer-Stuhlreihe, an der die Erzählung des Raums hängt. **Meine Empfehlung: den Bestand behalten.** Rückbau = ein Commit. (D-555, Bilder `pruefer/band_A_ausschnitt.png` gegen `band_B_ausschnitt.png`)

**(b) Die Lebensanzeige liest sich nicht als Gegner-Zustand.** Zwei unabhängige blinde Leser, dieselbe eine Frage, beide **NEIN** — der Chip steht neben »Regel-Seiten 0/5« und »Kleider 0/9« und liest sich dort als Sammel-Zähler. Zwischen den beiden Lesungen habe ich ihn wie bestellt von »Kritzel« auf »Tafel« umbenannt; es hat das Urteil nicht gedreht. Ehrlich dazu: **beide sahen 3/3**, weil ein abgenutzter Zustand nicht erreichbar war. **Meine Empfehlung: erst den Treiber bauen, dann neu blind lesen lassen.** (D-551)

---

## Was NICHT gelungen ist

**Die Boss-Zustands-Bilder mit den Schichten 1–3 und dem Wisch** (D-558). Drei Anläufe, jeder mit Zahlen: `--fight` friert bei Takt 251 und 478 ein (F8s D-450-Zahlen) und sein Kartenlöser feuert nie; über die Entwickler-Sonde 600 Takte ohne Bewegung; mit getriebenem Steuerkreuz erreicht das Kind die Tafel (Abstand 6 px), die aber ab Takt 1378 bis 2578 im Zustand `window` steht, ohne Karte. Kein vierter Anlauf. **Nicht behauptet wird, dass der Kampf für ein Kind stehenbleibt** — mein Treiber ist kein Mensch an einer Tastatur.

---

## PERF

Welle-7-Rezept, beide Server mit selbstgemeldetem Bau-Commit (`/api/version`, GEPRÜFT), Kontrollseite 61,4 fps, eigener Chrome, sichtbarer Tab. **Vorher `63e159b`, nachher `021d6ca`.** Der Vorher-Baum liegt einen Commit hinter `main`; die Differenz berührt `ci.yml`, das Schulden-Register und `check-ci-gates.mjs` — nichts, was zeichnet.

|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| p1 | 545 / 502,4 | 135,3 / 121,9 | 3 / 2,3 | 1,8 / 1,8 | 60,7 / 60,3 |
| p2 | 573,2 / 611,6 | 127,7 / 131,7 | 4,4 / 4,1 | 1,3 / 1,9 | 60,7 / 60,4 |
| p3 | 491,2 / 494,4 | 107,7 / 108,2 | 2,3 / 2,3 | 1,7 / 1,8 | 60,2 / 60,6 |
| p4 | 718,2 / **527,8** | 73,5 / **62,5** | 4,2 / 2,7 | 1,8 / 1,2 | 60,4 / 60,6 |

author: wlsdks
body:
소유자: *"buzz는 어떻게 하지 https://github.com/block/buzz 이거 오픈소스인데 참고해도 되면 참고하고"*

## 어제 내 결정이 틀렸다

원장 (95)는 Ghostty · Zed · Cap을 GitHub API로 확인하고 *"비교 대상은 셋 다 git 훅이 없다"*로 훅을 지웠다. **그 세 관측은 지금도 참이고, 틀린 것은 표본이다** — 이 저장소가 실제로 겨누는 Buzz를 안 봤다. 열어 보니 `block/buzz`에는 lefthook 기반 pre-push 훅이 있다.

같은 라운드에서 (95)가 「진 반대」로 적어 둔 **「빠른 것만 남기자」가 사실상 Buzz의 답**이었다. 기각 사유였던 「판정자가 둘이 된다」를 Buzz는 설정 주석 한 줄로 처리한다 — *"CI remains the authoritative gate."*

그리고 (95) 직후 첫 푸시에서 **내가 곧바로 검사를 골라 돌려 CI를 태웠다.** 훅이 없앤 것은 느림이 아니라 「고르지 못하게 하는 힘」이었다.

## 되살린 모양 — Buzz의 네 성질

| | 우리가 지운 것 | 이번 것 |
|---|---|---|
| 실행 | 직렬 | **병렬** |
| 범위 | 바뀐 파일 → 검사 전부 | **경로 글롭 레인** |
| 기준 | 푸시 범위 | **`origin/main...HEAD` 3점 diff** |
| e2e | 포함 | **없음** (CI가 3갈래) |

레인 열: `typecheck` · `lint` · `unit` · `i18n` · `agents` · `docs` · `mcp` + 무조건 도는 셋(`contract` · `comment-refs` · `decisions`). 실패한 레인의 로그만 출력한다 — 여덟이 동시에 떠들면 아무도 안 읽는다.

**새 의존성은 안 들였다.** Buzz는 lefthook을 Hermit로 고정해 쓰지만 우리는 이미 `.githooks/` 배선이 있고 네 성질은 셸로 된다.

## 실측 — 이 PR의 푸시가 그 증거다

```
[pre-push] 이 브랜치가 바꾼 9 개 파일로 레인을 고른다 (병렬)
[pre-push] 레인 8 개: typecheck lint unit agents docs contract comment_refs decisions
  ok ×8
[pre-push] 전부 통과. e2e 는 CI 가 본다 (병렬 3갈래).

2:06 total · CPU 926%
```

**2분 6초.** CPU 926%는 여덟 레인이 실제로 동시에 돌았다는 뜻이다. 직렬이면 같은 작업이 20분이고, 삭제 전 훅은 이 규모에서 12시간이었다. 경로 스코프도 동작했다 — `mcp/`·`messages/`를 안 건드려 그 두 레인이 안 켜졌다.

## 게이트와 프로브

`tests/contract/prepush-lanes.contract.test.ts`가 여덟을 잠근다: 병렬 · 3점 diff · e2e 부재 · 실패 레인만 출력 · 무조건 도는 레인 존재 · 레인이 부르는 스크립트 실재 · 글롭이 의도한 것만 켬 · 셸 문법.

프로브로 실제로 무는 것을 확인했다 — **직렬화** · **2점 diff** · **e2e 투입** · **스크립트 오타** 넷 다 빨개진다.

그 프로브가 **게이트 자신의 결함도 잡았다**: 스크립트 이름 정규식이 대문자를 안 먹어 `docs:surface:checkX`를 `docs:surface:check`로 **잘라 내고 통과**시켰다. 문자 클래스를 토큰 전체로 넓혔다.

## 딸린 정정 둘

**① 원장 번호가 겹쳐 있었다.** (95)를 쓸 때 `main`에 이미 (94)가 있는 것을 못 보고 같은 번호를 붙였고 그대로 머지됐다. 훅 결정을 (95)로 바로잡고 새 기록을 (96)으로 넣었다.

**② 그걸 막는 게이트를 달았더니 여덟이 더 나왔다.** 번호는 날짜마다 1부터 다시 시작하므로 판정 기준은 **날짜+번호**다 — 첫 초안이 번호만 보고 20건을 「겹침」이라 보고했는데 전부 정당했다. 그대로 켰으면 순수한 소음이었다.

실제 같은 날 겹침은 여덟이고 2026-08-14 하루에만 넷이다. 여러 브랜치가 같은 날 각자 「다음 번호」를 집은 것이라 한 사람의 실수가 아니다.

되돌려 번호를 다시 매기지 **않는다** — 다른 기록이 이미 번호로 인용하고 있고, 원장의 계약이 「덧붙이기만 한다」이다. 상한 8의 래칫으로 두고 **아홉 번째를 막는다.** 프로브: 겹침을 하나 더하니 빨개졌다.

## Test plan

푸시가 훅을 통과한 것 자체가 8레인 검증이다. 추가로 `tsc` 0 error · 계약 **2,036** · `agents:check` · `docs:links`.

원장: `docs/DECISIONS.md` 2026-08-22 (96) — (95)를 뒤집음. (95)에는 뒤집힘 표시와 사유를 남겼다.

author: cl445
body:
Found while implementing TG11 (#2245) — not by a failing test, but by a
mutation that stayed green when it should not have.

## The defect

`trigger_trv_change` asks about the same flag three times and answers one of
them differently:

| Line | Guard | Governs |
|---|---|---|
| `events/trv.py:271` | `not child_lock` | updating the mode cache |
| `events/trv.py:284` | `child_lock is False` | adopting the mode into `bt_hvac_mode` |
| `events/trv.py:345` | `not child_lock` | adopting the setpoint |

A config entry written before the option existed carries no `child_lock` key
at all, and `async_migrate_entry` never adds one (it backfills
`no_system_mode_off` and `calibration_mode`, not this). The flag then arrives
as `None`, and `is False` simply never takes the branch.

**Symptom on such an entry:** turning the dial on the TRV changes the
temperature Better Thermostat holds, but never the mode it runs in. The
device's new mode *is* recorded — only the adoption is skipped — so nothing
logs an error.

## Why unlocked is the right reading

Four other places already encode it:

- `config_flow.py:339` — `_as_bool(normalized.get(CONF_CHILD_LOCK), False)`
- `switch.py:194` — `(trv.advanced or {}).get("child_lock", False)`, so the
  child lock switch shows *off* for a missing key
- `events/trv.py:271` and `:345` — both pass when the flag is absent

`model_fixes/default.py:88` uses `is not None`, but asks a different question
(*was this configured at all, should I push it to the device's lock entity*)
and is left alone.

## Blast radius

For every entry the config flow has written, `child_lock` is a bool, where
`child_lock is False` and `not child_lock` are the same test — nothing changes
there. Only entries missing the key behave differently, and only in the
direction of matching what the UI already claims about them.

Of 7105 tests, exactly one depended on the old behaviour:
`test_child_lock_none_blocks_mode_propagation`, added by #1925 — a
characterisation suite for a then-untested handler ("*several suspicious
patterns that needed verification through tests*"), not a design statement.
It now pins the intended behaviour, next to a new test that the two ways of
not being locked stay one behaviour.

Both new tests were checked by reverting the production change: both go red.

## Checks

- `uv run pytest tests/` — 7106 passed, 1 skipped
- `uv run ruff check` / `format --check` — clean
- `uv run pyrefly check` — 0 errors
- `scripts/coverage_floors.py check` — all 99 modules hold their floor

<!-- This is an auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->
## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **Bug Fixes**
  * Thermostat mode changes now propagate correctly when the child lock setting is missing, treating the device as unlocked.
  * Missing and explicitly disabled child-lock settings now behave consistently.

* **Tests**
  * Added coverage for thermostat behavior with absent and disabled child-lock configurations.

author: frankekn
body:
Closes #47.

## Problem

1. **Needlefish's own PRs had no CI.** `review.yml` runs the *deployed* reviewer against a PR — it never runs the candidate branch's `pnpm check` / `lint` / `test`. None of the six existing workflows was a CI workflow.
2. **Every push to `main` deployed, untested**, straight onto the self-hosted production review runner:
   ```yaml
   on: { push: { branches: [main] } }
   jobs: { deploy: { runs-on: self-hosted, steps: [checkout, scripts/deploy-ubuntu.sh] } }
   ```
   `release.yml`'s verification happens later and does not protect `main`.

## Change

**New `ci.yml`** — `pull_request` + `push` to `main`, on `ubuntu-latest`, pinned Corepack pnpm, `--frozen-lockfile`, then `pnpm check` / `lint` / `test`.

**`deploy.yml` loses `on.push`** and waits on `workflow_run` of `needlefish-ci`.

### Why `workflow_run` (option b)

`needs:` cannot cross workflow files. Verification must stay on `ubuntu-latest` so a broken `main` never occupies the production runner, while deploy must stay on `self-hosted` — so a single-file design would either put PR CI inside the deploy workflow or duplicate the verify job.

### Why a failing SHA cannot deploy

1. A push to `main` starts **only** `needlefish-ci`; `deploy.yml` has no `push` trigger.
2. Deploy runs on `workflow_run: completed`, gated on **all** of:
   ```yaml
   github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' &&
   github.event.workflow_run.event == 'push' &&
   github.event.workflow_run.head_branch == 'main'
   ```
3. **`event == 'push'` is load-bearing, not belt-and-braces:** `workflow_run` branch matching can treat a PR's *base* as `main`, so without it a green PR targeting `main` would deploy.
4. Red, cancelled, or PR-triggered runs skip the job — no self-hosted occupancy at all.

### Why the deployed SHA is the verified SHA

`scripts/deploy-ubuntu.sh` installs whatever `NEEDLEFISH_REF` points at (fetched into its own temp clone) — **not** the Actions workspace. So the workflow threads the verified SHA through:

- takes `github.event.workflow_run.head_sha`, **not** `github.sha` (which on `workflow_run` resolves to the default-branch tip)
- format-checks it as 40 lowercase hex at both the resolve and deploy steps
- checks out that SHA and exports `NEEDLEFISH_REF=<that SHA>`

**Race** (a second push lands while the first CI is in flight): the deploy compares the verified SHA against `git ls-remote origin main` and **skips** if it is no longer the tip. It never installs a newer, unverified tip on the strength of an older green run — that newer SHA deploys from its own green run. CI concurrency cancels superseded `main` runs, and a cancelled run is not a success. Manual dispatch skips the tip check so rollback still works.

`workflow_dispatch` stays ungated as the recovery path — which is also what `weekly-eval.yml:82` already uses (`gh workflow run deploy.yml --ref main`), so that path keeps working unchanged.

## Verification

**Fork safety, checked directly:** `ci.yml` is `pull_request` (not `pull_request_target`) ✅, `permissions: contents: read` ✅, contains **no** `secrets.` reference ✅.

`scripts/ci-deploy-workflow.test.mjs` pins the gate. **Mutation-verified:**

| Mutation | Result |
|---|---|
| baseline | `pass 4 / fail 0` |
| drop `conclusion == 'success'` | `pass 3 / fail 1` ✅ |
| deploy `github.sha` instead of the verified `head_sha` | `pass 3 / fail 1` ✅ |
| drop the `event == 'push'` guard | `pass 3 / fail 1` ✅ |
| CI stops running `pnpm test` | `pass 3 / fail 1` ✅ |

author: keepsync-hub
body:
Two changes to the microphone: one to what it can hear, one to when it hears at all.

## Chords

**Subtract the envelope, don't erase the bands.** Accepting a note used to zero its partials out of the spectrum, which erases any other note sharing one — and in a chord that is the norm. In an octave the upper note's fundamental *is* the lower note's second partial, so the upper note was not merely hard to hear, it was unhearable. Measured against the old code:

| | before | after |
| --- | --- | --- |
| C3 + C4 (octave) | `[C3]` | `[C3, C4]` |
| SATB chord, blind | `[C3, G3, E4]` | `[C3, G3, E4]` |
| SATB chord, in practice mode | — | `[C3, G3, E4, G4]` |

What is subtracted now is the *smoothed* envelope of the note's partials (3-point moving average, clipped to the observed peak). A lone note's partials decay smoothly and come out almost whole; a partial shared with another note stands out against its neighbours, the moving average falls short of it, and the excess — which is the other note — survives.

**A second pass guided by the expected notes.** In practice mode the gate already knows which notes it is waiting for. Deciding *"which notes are sounding?"* blind is the hard problem; checking *"is this particular note sounding?"* is an easy one, and it is what recovers the quiet inner voices of a dense chord.

**The order of the two passes is the opposite of the intuitive one, and that is the point.** Guiding first would accept notes nobody played: if C4 is sounding and C5 is expected, C4's partials *are* C5's harmonic series, so C5 would pass on borrowed evidence. Searching blind first claims them for C4 and subtracts them, leaving nothing to sustain C5. There is a test for exactly this.

Each expected note still has to show energy at its own fundamental and above the noise floor, so a chord you did not play is not accepted for you. What the guidance removes is only the *relative* threshold between notes, which is what used to drop a voice for being softer than the loudest one.

The blind pass is unchanged and still conservative — it is what feeds the error counter, so wrong notes are still caught blind.

## When it listens

The microphone now opens only in practice mode. The browser asks the first time **Practice** is pressed rather than on load, and the recording indicator goes out again on the way back to Listen — it is only ever open while it has something to do. `micEnabled` stops being state and becomes `micPreferred && mode === 'practice'`; the toggle and the remembered denial work exactly as before.

A new `'idle'` status says *starts in practice mode* rather than reporting the microphone off when it is switched on and simply waiting. Adding it to `MicStatus` made the compiler point at both places that map the status. The settings block was also moved out from behind the *listening* condition, so sensitivity and the checkboxes stay reachable outside practice mode; only the live meter and note readout are gated.

## Verification

- `npm run lint` clean, **137 tests** (6 new), `npm run build` succeeds.
- New detector tests: the octave chord (impossible before this change); all four SATB voices found when guided; an expected note that is not sounding is rejected; an expected note cannot ride on another note's harmonics; the four-voice limit **blind** is still asserted rather than quietly dropped.
- The before/after table above was measured by running the previous `detectNotes` and the new one side by side on the same synthetic spectra.
- Driven in real Chromium: on load in Listen the microphone is not opened (status *Starts in Practice mode*, no capture); pressing **Practice** takes it to *Listening* with a live meter; returning to Listen releases the stream. Zero console errors.

**Not verified:** a real piano through a real microphone — unchanged from the previous PRs, the container has no audio input. The chord results above are from synthetic spectra with clean harmonic series; a real piano adds inharmonicity, pedal blur and room noise, so treat four-voice recall as promising rather than proven.

author: junkovich
body:
## Why

Third concern out of `ci.yml`, following the pattern `lint.yml` and
`security.yml` set in #934 and #936. `audit`, `dependency-review`, and
`npm-license` become `.github/workflows/deps.yml`, so a red check names the
policy that fired instead of the file. `ci.yml` drops from 15 jobs to 12 and
loses 103 lines.

## Contexts

For the ruleset session, add when convenient. `CI gate` covers the transition:

- `deps / cargo-deny`
- `deps / npm-licenses`
- `deps / review`

`deps / changes` also reports and stays un-required, per the rule
`.github/workflows/README.md` records.

Gating carries over unchanged: `cargo-deny` on `audit`, `npm-licenses` on
`npm`, and `review` unfiltered but `pull_request`-only, which is why it shows
as skipped on `push` and `merge_group`. The `allow-ghsas` list, the license
allowlist, and the exclude-by-name set all move verbatim.

## Empty tool list now skips mise

`npm-licenses` needs the JS workspace and no pinned command-line tool. The
composite setup action previously read an empty `mise-install-args` as "install
everything `mise.toml` pins", which for this job means building the
source-installed Rust tools it never runs. Empty now skips the mise step
entirely. All eight existing call sites pass an explicit tool list, so nothing
else changes.

## Cache considered and rejected

A cargo-deny advisory-DB cache was the obvious addition here. Measured on the
last five `main` runs first: the whole `cargo deny check` step is 15s including
the DB fetch, inside a 23-28s job. A ~50MB restore and save costs about what it
would save. Same verdict the trivy and opengrep caches got in #936, for the
same reason: the mise tool cache already covers where the time goes.

## Composite action added to six filters

Second commit, and the reason it is worth reading separately. The setup action
now holds the mise and vp pins for every concern job, but only the `workflows`
filter covered `.github/actions/**`. So a pin bump in the composite could
change what `security / iac`, `security / openapi`, `security / sast`, and both
new dependency jobs run without the filter gating them ever firing. `backend`
already handled its equivalent explicitly for `rust-toolchain`; this extends
the same treatment to `setup` across `backend`, `frontend`, `iac`, `openapi`,
`audit`, and `npm`.

## Verification

This pull request checks its own filter wiring. `deps.yml` is in the `audit`
and `npm` filters, so `deps / cargo-deny` and `deps / npm-licenses` must run
live here rather than skip. If either skips, the filter addition did not take.

Locally green: `actionlint`, `zizmor`, `yamllint`, `preflight-scope-selftest`,
and the full `infra::lint` mirror. The scoped gate escalates to the full lane
set on any `path-filters.yml` edit; nothing here touches Rust or JS source, so
CI is the gate for the rest.

Part of the UNK-574 CI restructure.

Bu, bilinen bir tuzağı da kapatıyor: "How many years of experience do you have with Microsoft Azure?" sorusu genel `how many years` kuralına düşüp C#/.NET yılını yazıyordu; bir kez elle cevaplandıktan sonra doğrusu hatırlanıyor.

author: codemoo
body:
## Summary

When upstream explicitly rejects a proxy-injected previous_response_id, the HTTP bridge can retain and re-inject that dead anchor. The client full resend is then trimmed against an anchor upstream no longer recognizes; repeated failures open the retry circuit and surface as recurring 503 cooldown responses.

This PR retires the explicitly denied anchor and closes the remaining publication-versus-dispatch race. It supersedes #1872 because the final race fix could not be pushed to that contributor fork branch.

## Type of change

- [x] fix: bug fix (no behavior change beyond the bug)

Linked issue: Refs #1852. This is a focused partial fix: it handles explicit upstream denial of proxy-managed anchors but does not change the separate poison-threshold arithmetic described in that issue.

## OpenSpec

- [x] This PR includes / updates an OpenSpec change
- [x] This PR touches a codex-faithful path and preserves upstream-equivalent behavior

Change directory: openspec/changes/invalidate-denied-bridge-anchor/

The downstream contract stays unchanged: the denied turn remains a 502 stream_incomplete response. The proxy adds no speculative redispatch.

## Changes

- Retire only a matching proxy-injected, full-resend anchor after upstream returns previous_response_not_found.
- Fence durable cleanup by session scope, owner, and denied response ID; preserve sibling response and turn-state aliases.
- Clear the in-memory carrier even when durable or registry bookkeeping fails, without overwriting a concurrently advanced newer anchor.
- Publish a denied-anchor tombstone under the session lifecycle lock shared with final request revalidation, enqueue, and upstream send.
- Reject prepared requests carrying the denied anchor before another upstream frame can be sent.
- Preserve proxy-anchor provenance on anchored recovery retries.
- Add unit and product-path integration regressions, including a coordinated retirement-versus-dispatch race.

## Test plan

- 650 passed, 1 deselected in tests/unit/test_proxy_http_bridge.py.
- 132 passed in tests/integration/test_http_responses_bridge.py.
- 4 passed in the focused publication/dispatch and product-path regressions.
- Ruff check and format check passed.
- ty check passed.
- scripts/check_proxy_architecture.py passed.
- openspec validate invalidate-denied-bridge-anchor --strict passed.
- git diff --check passed.
- Repository-standard Codex review on head 03a6454a returned no findings (session 01a029b3-d3dc-7fc3-bf2f-0fb9c2cef09e).

Known upstream baselines:

- test_stream_via_http_bridge_fails_closed_before_file_affinity_when_previous_response_owner_misses fails identically on pristine upstream main because the file_account_pins table is absent.
- The locally installed openspec validate --specs reports the same eight pre-existing invalid specs on this branch and upstream main; strict validation of this change is green.

## Screenshots / output

Before the fix, the same proxy-managed anchor can be denied, re-injected, and followed by retry-circuit cooldown responses:

    previous_response_not_found
    session_anchor_injected response_id=<same denied id>
    store_context_input_trimmed original_items=248 trimmed_to=6
    http_bridge_retry_circuit event=opened failures=2
    proxy_error_response status=503 message="... cooling down ..."

After the fix, the denied turn remains 502, the anchor is retired, and the next full-resend turn dispatches without that previous_response_id.

## Simplicity

No new setting, default, setup step, README section, environment entry, dashboard navigation item, schema, or migration is added.

## Checklist

- [x] Title is in Conventional Commits format.
- [x] Linked the related issue and existing PR.
- [x] Added unit and product-path integration coverage.
- [x] Ran the relevant local CI subsets.
- [x] Strict OpenSpec change validation passes; repository-wide local baseline failures are documented above.
- [x] Simplicity gates P1-P5 reviewed.
- [x] CHANGELOG is not edited by hand.

<!-- This is an auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->
## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **Bug Fixes**
  * Improved handling when upstream services reject proxy-injected continuity anchors.
  * Rejected anchors are retired promptly across active and successor sessions, preventing reuse.
  * Prevented known-invalid anchors from being dispatched or restored during retries.
  * Preserved newer continuity data, unrelated aliases, and client-provided anchors during cleanup.
  * Added safeguards for concurrent requests, cancellations, replica synchronization, timeouts, and partial cleanup failures.
  * Recovery retries retain continuity context only when the rejected anchor is resent.
  * Requests requiring recovery now return a clear `502 stream_incomplete` response with continuity diagnostics.

author: turquet78
body:
Elle ne se déplaçait que par sa barre de titre, un ruban d'une trentaine de pixels qu'il fallait viser. Sa poignée est désormais la **carte entière**.

## Le piège d'à côté

Une carte qui prend tous les clics avale ceux de ses **propres boutons**, qui deviennent muets sans lever la moindre erreur. La liste `GESTE_PROPRE` rend son geste à tout ce qui se clique, se tape ou se choisit, et elle ne se limite pas à `<button>` : un lien dans un rappel de cours, un champ, une liste suffiraient à rouvrir le trou.

Le glisser coupe la sélection du texte, et c'est posé dans `rendreDeplacable()` plutôt que dans la feuille de styles, parce que la poignée n'est plus toujours l'en-tête : saisir la fenêtre et sélectionner son texte sont le même geste, et le navigateur ferait les deux à la fois. **Le texte du conseil n'est donc plus sélectionnable** — prix assumé.

## Où le changement se voit

La Première et la Terminale **détachent** le soutien dans une vraie fenêtre du système dès que le pointeur est fin ; c'est alors le gestionnaire de fenêtres qui la déplace, et la carte de la page n'existe plus. Le changement se voit donc là où le détachement n'est pas possible — et en Seconde, qui ne détache pas le soutien.

## Le contrôle

Il vit dans le banc navigateur : jsdom n'a ni `PointerEvent` ni mise en page, donc aucune position à mesurer. Il tient les deux bords **ensemble**, parce que n'en tenir qu'un ne tient rien — la fenêtre doit *suivre* la souris saisie en plein texte, et ses boutons doivent *garder* leur geste.

Il s'est pris lui-même en défaut sur le bord le plus important. Il mesurait la position **après** avoir relâché la souris : or la carte suit le curseur, donc le bouton reste dessous, le clic part quand même, « Fermer » referme la fenêtre — et une fenêtre fermée n'a plus de rectangle. Le contrôle se satisfaisait de ce « elle a bien agi » alors qu'elle venait d'être traînée de quatre cents pixels. Il mesure maintenant **pointeur encore enfoncé**, et les quatre sabotages rougissent :

| sabotage | |
|---|---|
| retour à la barre de titre comme seule poignée | ✗ rouge |
| la poignée avale les clics de ses boutons | ✗ rouge |
| l'exclusion ne connaît plus que les liens | ✗ rouge |
| la fenêtre ne suit plus que sur un axe | ✗ rouge |

`npm test` (145 / 126 / 110) et `npm run test:navigateur` (105 / 69 / 67) sont verts sur les trois niveaux.

`secondes.html` v62 → v63, `premiere-specifique.html` v139 → v140, `terminale.html` v236 → v237.

author: b2techstudio
dantheman1991
body:
Found by opening the matching screen on the **live app** — the first time this pack has been looked at with real data in it.

A kill day's output — *"Whole broilers · Kill day 2026-08-21"*, and the chicken backs beside it — was sitting in **deliveries with no invoice yet**, next to a draft lumber bill for $16,677.33. The screen was inviting somebody to match the two.

## What was wrong

`postMovement` already knew better: a **produced** or **raised** lot credits the *consumption* account, not GRNI, because a run's inputs were charged there on the way in and its output credits the same account on the way out. `unbilledReceipts` did not know it, and listed every priced receipt whatever its provenance.

Only the first consequence is visible:

1. The list offers stock **no supplier ever sold the business**.
2. **The GRNI working could never agree with the account** — made goods were in one and not the other, and the card blames any difference on "deliveries from before the switch", which would have been wrong every time.
3. Matching one would point a bill line at GRNI to clear **a credit that was never made** — the same failure as matching with posting off, arriving through provenance instead of through a setting.

## The fix

One shared predicate, `owesASupplier`, used by both ends so they cannot drift again. Lot-less stock counts as bought, which is what a receipt with no batch almost always is, and is what posting already assumed.

## Note on a test

One existing test had to become a **differential** measurement rather than an absolute one. This file shares a single tenant across its suites, so *"the gap is at least $70"* was quietly a claim about every test before it as much as about itself — it now measures what the delivery under test does to both figures.

## Checks

- `npm run lint`, `npx tsc --noEmit`, 40 posting tests
- No migrations

# Summary Adds an endpoint that lists companies operating on a specific route by origin and destination.
## Changes - Adds the `list-routes` module following the controller/service/repository structure and registers it on `AppModule` - Adds `GET /list-routes?origin=&destination=` returning active routes with company name, origin, destination, price, departure and arrival locations, and route number - Validates required querystrings with a dedicated DTO, trimming incoming values - Matches origin and destination case-insensitively so the front-end city select does not depend on exact casing - Supports optional `priceOrder=asc|desc` querystring to sort results by price, defaulting to `asc` - Adds unit tests for the service covering delegation to the repository, pass-through of results, default behavior without `priceOrder` and error propagation
## Why this approach? / Justification - GET with querystrings keeps the operation idempotent and cacheable, which fits the read-only nature of a route search - Filtering and ordering happen in the database through a single Prisma `findMany`, so the endpoint scales as more companies operate the same route - Only ACTIVE routes are returned, preventing exposure of routes that are not currently operating - The service is tested against a mocked repository, keeping the tests isolated from the database and focused on the contract between layers

author: scandalousman
body:
Phase 4 of `001-steam-link-replay-ingestion` — User Story 2, "Never lose another replay" — plus the
two defects the post-phase `/speckit-analyze` pass turned up in work already marked done.

The replay retention window is about 31 days and an uncaptured replay is lost forever, so this is
the phase the architecture exists for: discovery finds new matches for every consenting linked
profile, capture archives the bytes well inside the window, and the whole thing reports its own
absence rather than failing silently at four in the morning.

## What lands

**Ingestion.** The three US2 providers and the ingester's rate-limit policy for the replay endpoint.
Discovery reconciles every consenting linked profile and clears the backfill flag. Capture uploads
before marking, validates reclaimed bytes rather than trusting them, reads a 404 three ways from the
match's own age, bounds retries and fails terminally at the ceiling, and drains under a per-user
fairness quota that governs the real drain rather than a parallel code path.

**Observability.** An `ingest_runs` row opens before the work and closes after it, so an interrupted
run is visible as an interrupted run. One deadline-breach alert per run, not one per match. The
nightly checks — cron liveness, capture audit, alert audit — turn an alert into something a person
actually sees, and a cron cycle now genuinely runs the ingestion stages. `GET /api/replays/status`
reports a profile's capture backlog.

**Two analyze findings, recorded as tasks and fixed here.**

- **T053a** — a GDPR defect in code already deployed. `_consenting_profile_ids` selected on
  `ingest_consent_at IS NOT NULL` alone. T032 deliberately never clears that column on withdrawal —
  it is the record of what was agreed and when — so the query answered "consented" forever from the
  first grant onward and FR-035's withdrawal did nothing at all to ingestion: a user who withdrew
  kept having their matches discovered, their ratings polled and their captures enqueued,
  indefinitely. The second clause `ingest_consent_withdrawn_at IS NULL` was already stated in
  `contracts/http-api.md` twice, which is why this read as covered on a walk through the artifacts.
  The existing consent test passed because it seeded a user who *never granted*, never one who
  *withdrew*; it now seeds both.
- **T061a** — `scripts/checks/` was outside three separate gates, and the one that mattered was
  `pr.yml`'s `python` path filter, which omitted `scripts/**`. A pull request touching only those
  files ran no Python job at all, so the tests written to cover them did not run in CI on precisely
  the changes they exist to cover. The four older scripts had never been linted or type-checked;
  their findings are fixed here and are pre-existing rather than introduced.

## Nine more, from the review pass over this branch

A `/code-review` pass over the finished branch found nine further defects, recorded as tasks in the
same remediation section and fixed here, one commit each. Two of them were one failure wearing two
faces and are worth reading together:

- **T050a** — `recent_matches` called `parse_strict` in a bare loop, so one entry the source sent
  that did not validate raised out of the provider and took discovery, reconciliation and the drain
  with it, every cycle, until that entry left the recent window. An unfinished match was enough:
  `RawMatch.completed_at` is required, and a *recent match history* endpoint reports games still
  being played. The silent half was worse than the loud one — `_epoch_seconds_to_datetime(0)` is a
  real datetime, not a sentinel, so Relic's other convention for "in progress" parsed as completed
  at the Unix epoch, sorted first in every claim order and read as expired decades early.
- **T061b** — and the check that exists to notice that reads only whether a run *started*.
  `run.py` documents two liveness signals, a missing row and an open `finished_at`, and T059 opens
  the row before any stage precisely so the second one exists; nothing read it. A cron firing on
  schedule while every run died wrote a fresh `started_at` every night and the check printed OK.

The other seven lose one capture at a time: **T059b** (a `deadline_breach` re-raised every cycle
with no dedup and no exclusion of terminal states, so `alert_audit` could never return to green),
**T049a** (any non-404 status read as replay bytes, uploaded, committed and permanently
quarantined), **T055a** (`CancelledError` inherits `BaseException`, so a graceful restart quarantined
a valid, already-durable capture), **T054b** (reconciliation checked consent against the batch where
discovery deliberately checks the whole cycle), **T060a** (a fresh httpx client, engine and token
bucket per invocation, none released — and a bucket that starts full re-arms the rate limit every
cycle), **T059c** (the drain's three alert producers wrote a null `ingest_run_id`, orphaning exactly
the alerts the early row insert was designed to serve), and **T061c** (the strict gate's file list
was restated rather than derived, so the next script added would silently go untyped).

## Verification

`uv run pytest` — 390 passed, nothing skipped, no unexpected xpass. `uv run ruff format --check .`,
`uv run ruff check` and `uv run mypy` clean across the workspace, now including `scripts/`.

The US2 independent test — link an active player, run cycles until the backlog empties, confirm
every match from the preceding 31 days whose replay is still available is `stored` and downloads
byte-for-byte identical — is **not** covered by this run. It needs a real account with recent online
play and is walked by hand at T105.

## Still open, deliberately

**T089a** is the other half of T053a and is not in this PR. T053a gates *discovery*, which decides
whose matches are found; T089a gates the *claim*, which decides whose bytes are fetched. They are
not the same check, because a queue sits between them that can be days deep: a capture enqueued
while consent stood is still `pending` after a withdrawal, and the claim query has no consent clause
of any kind. It belongs to Phase 7 (US5) and is written up in `tasks.md`.

Branch note: this work was committed on `fix/web-tailwind-source-detection`, whose name it long
outgrew — PRs #4 and #5 merged from there. Pushed under a name that describes it.

Review note: the nine remediation tasks were found by review, not by the suite. Each one had a test
written that failed against the committed code before the fix went in, so the gap each defect
travelled through is closed by something that would catch it again.

author: jrosskopf
body:
Bumps `erpl_tunnel` from `2026.08.07` to `2026.08.22` ([release](https://github.com/DataZooDE/erpl-tunnel/releases/tag/v2026.08.22)).

## What changed

**Registering a function name the catalog already holds no longer aborts the whole `LOAD`.** `ExtensionLoader::RegisterFunction(PragmaFunction)` and the `CreateTableFunctionInfo` overload leave `on_conflict` at `ERROR_ON_CONFLICT`, so a pre-existing entry under one of our names took the extension down with `Pragma Function with name "tunnel_create" already exists!`, leaving it half-registered (`loaded = false`, some functions silently missing). Registrations now replace a conflicting entry.

This matters because the companion `erpl` extension has dropped its own bundled SSH tunnel and leaves deprecation stubs under these names pointing here — so the two need to be loadable together.

Plus per-platform smoke tests of the shipped artifact, and a CI fix for the v1.4.5 Windows and Linux arm64 builds.

## Note on `vcpkg_commit`

This bump adds an explicit `vcpkg_commit: 84bab45d…`, matching the default this repo already uses for DuckDB v1.5.5.

The extension's `vcpkg.json` now carries a `builtin-baseline` of that commit in order to hold `openssl` at 3.5.0: openssl 3.6.0 requires Linux kernel headers that the arm64 build container does not carry, and fails with `building openssl:arm64-linux-release failed with: BUILD_FAILED`. Without the pin, non-`v1.5.5` builds would fall back to the older `ce613c41…` default, which predates that baseline.

author: craigbalding
body:
## Summary

**Stacked on #288** (pr1-preview-disconnect-resilience).

The `serve_agent_preview` finally block ran cleanup steps in a straight line: any raise from `tailnet_session.close()` skipped `server.server_close` and dropped the `agent.preview_close` audit event; any raise from `server_close` dropped the event too. A dead `try/except: raise` at the top of the function pretended to protect startup but did nothing. And `webbrowser.open` at the "open the URL" step ran unwrapped — on headless hosts or with a broken `\$BROWSER` launcher, it could take down the whole preview before `serve_forever` ever started.

- Remove the no-op `try/except Exception: raise` in `serve_agent_preview`.
- Wrap each cleanup step in the finally block in its own try/except so a failure in one does not skip the others.
- Wrap `webbrowser.open` in try/except and print a warning to stderr; the preview URL is already printed to stdout, so the user can open it manually.

## Test plan

Regression tests use event capture + a small `_RaisingTailnetSession` fake and a broken `webbrowser.open` monkeypatch (no MagicMock):
- [x] tailnet close raise still runs `server_close` and writes `preview_close`
- [x] `server_close` raise still writes `preview_close`
- [x] broken `webbrowser` launcher warns on stderr and preview still opens/closes

body:
Deployed at `e54730c`, 13:55 UTC. Verified **on the server**, rather than inferred from the script exiting cleanly — which matters here specifically, because #271's whole point is a screen that makes a claim about the host.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Running code matches `main` | app tree `f815319…` identical both sides |
| Both System migrations | recorded, in create-then-correct order |
| Premigration snapshot record | `version 1`, `premigrate`, `drive:lesson3-backups`, 7,108,463 bytes, filename carries `e54730c` |
| App can read it | yes |
| **App can write it** | **no — `Read-only file system`** |

Two of those are worth more than the rest. The record was produced by the **script**, so the parser's contract now holds against a real file and not only against test fixtures. And the sole-writer property is confirmed in production: the parity spec I added asserts the `:ro` exists in `docker-compose.yml`, but only `docker compose exec app touch …` proves the kernel enforces it on the running container. Without that, the row would still have been the app's opinion of itself as far as anyone could show.

Section 9 of `system_panel_functions.md` said "Not deployed yet" and is now the verification record. Its caveats survive unchanged: a *Premigration* success is not a nightly schedule (that reads *Daily*), and no record of any kind proves the dump restores — the drill in `docs/OPS.md` is still owed.

## ⚑ One thing verifying turned up, recorded rather than fixed in passing

`/srv/lesson3/out/` is a **pre-existing host directory** with unrelated contents — three `Biology_Chemicals_of_Life_*.docx` from June, `backup.log`, `prune.log`, `ares-data/`, `ares-demo/` — and `docker-compose.yml` mounts **all of it** at `/var/run/lesson3-ops:ro`.

Nothing there is secret and nothing can be written, so this is not an exposure. But the app can read more than the one file it wants, and the design comment reads as though that directory exists for this purpose. A dedicated `out/ops/` narrows it to exactly the contract: one compose line, one script line, two path assertions in `backupStatusPathParity.spec.ts`, no migration. Left as a decision rather than slipped in, since it changes a mount and therefore needs a deploy to take effect.

## 实测把分工钉死了

同一天，GitHub 托管 runner 与一条住宅宽带各跑一遍：

| 数据源 | 托管 runner | 住宅 IP |
|---|---|---|
| **DOS 公告**（表A/表B cutoff） | ✅ 200 —— 走 `adoption.state.gov` 镜像 | ✅ 200 |
| **USCIS AOS 递交用表** | ❌ **403** | ✅ 200 |

WAF 规则挂在 hostname 上，不是按出口 IP 段封。**排期数字托管 runner 就能抓到，不需要自建 runner**；真正只有住宅 IP 能做的，只剩「问一次 USCIS 用表」这一个 HTTP 请求。

命中路径已端到端验证：`probe_published(2026,9)` → `strong` + `looks_like_bulletin` 通过。

## 改动

### 1. 用表独立成常驻值守 · `scripts/uscis_chart_watch.sh`

为一个每小时一次的 HTTP 请求注册 GitHub runner、跑常驻服务、承担离线排队风险，是杀鸡用牛刀。一个 cron 就够。

**是值守，不是跑一次就完** —— 实测 2026-09 期公告 8/14 发布，到 8/22 USCIS 仍挂着「Coming soon」。拿不到就继续每小时问；判定出 A/B 后 `resolve_filing_chart()` 自己短路（不再发请求），成本趋近于零；下一期公告把 `FILING_CHART` 重置回 `'?'`，值守自动重新开始。出结果推 Bark + 自动 commit push。

`data-update.yml` 的用表步骤加了 `if: runner.environment == 'self-hosted'` —— 在托管 runner 上跑那一步必然 403，只会写下「获取失败」，掩盖「USCIS 尚未公布」这个真相（今天线上就是这么坏的）。

### 2. 修「`error` 状态被永久焊死」

`resolve_filing_chart` 原来嗅探 `index.html` 里已有的 `'error'` 就不覆盖 —— 于是托管 runner（403）留下的 error 会把后来真正抓通的结果永远挡在门外。

`fetch_filing_chart()` 改为返回 `(chart, fetched_ok)`，状态由调用方按**本次**是否取回页面来写。「够不着 USCIS」和「USCIS 还没更新」是两种状态，前端措辞不同，两台机器可达性也不同，不能合并。

### 3. 修 #31 引入的对称回归

#31 把 `grab()` 的窗口改成「截到下一个任意表头」，在 CI 上第一次真实运行就被它自己加的告警抓住：

```
[debug] 'Final Action Date' 表头@44183 → 1st 段: '未找到 1st'
[parse] ⚠️ 锚定失败，改用位置兜底（表A=兜底，表B=正常）
```

两张表的标题短语都会在自己的说明文字里再次出现，"下一个表头"匹配到的是自己的回声。三种边界只有第三种成立：

| 边界 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| 固定字符窗口 | 表B 的说明文字 >700 字符，够不着 |
| 下一个任意表头 | 被自己的标题回声截断 |
| **对方那张表的锚点** | 边界唯一，且天然把两张表隔开 ✓ |

测试同时加严：新增 `parse_strict()` 捕获 stdout、断言兜底告警未出现。**只比对数值测不出锚定失效** —— 位置兜底很容易把值蒙对，表B 的老毛病正是这样藏了两个月，这个新回归也照样「值对但锚定已失效」。新用例在旧实现上确实失败。

### 4. 收窄 fail-open 的 `except`

`runner_window.py` 里一个 `NameError` 曾被 `except Exception` 吞成「读不到 release_log」并静默降级成"开"。改为只兜网络/解析错，代码错原样抛出。跟位置兜底同一个毛病：兜底把 bug 兜没了。

### 5. `runner_window.py` 不再为抓公告长开

原规则「下月期未定案 + 7–26 号 → 开」等于每月让本机白开两周，换来托管 runner 已经能做的事。改为只在「过了 20 号仍没抓到」时接管（历史 12 期发布日全部落在 12–20），即托管探测疑似失效时的保险。用表规则移除 —— 值守脚本接管了。

### 6. 文档

- **`DATA_SOURCES.md`**：新增「抓取可达性」表 + 三条规矩。并更正原文「travel.state.gov 对 runner 返回 403」—— 容易被读成按 IP 段封。
- **`README.md`**：「数据自动更新」整段重写，原文两句话都不准。
- **`CLAUDE_CODE_BOOTSTRAP.md`**：新增「运维现状」节，记下那个咬了三次的 bug 模式（固定窗口 + 静默兜底）与两条纪律；补全 `scripts/` 清单（原来还写着不存在的 `scrape_uscis.py`）。

## 数据侧

- 2026-09 期 `A=2023-07-01` `B=2023-12-01`，与 `index.html` 现值一致 —— 8/14 那条人工录入无误。
- 2026-08 递交用表实测为 **表A（Final Action Dates）**。
- 2026-09 用表 USCIS **尚未公布**（官网「Coming soon」）。`FILING_CHART_STATE` 从 `error` 改回 `pending`，前端因此显示「USCIS 逾期未公布」而非误导性的「获取失败」。

`scripts/test_sniff.py` 全绿（7 项，其中 3 项为本 PR 及 #31 新增，均经反向验证）。

## 合并后

```bash
git checkout main && git pull
bash scripts/uscis_chart_watch.sh --install
```

author: darkwixxard
body:
Bindet einen Pi-hole im LAN als Plugin ein. Der neue PiholeService fragt Kennzahlen, Top-Listen und den 24-Stunden-Verlauf ab und erkennt dabei selbst, welche API-Generation antwortet:

  * v6 - FTL-REST unter /api, Login gegen /api/auth, Session als X-FTL-SID-Header (wird bei 401 automatisch erneuert, beim Herunterfahren wieder abgemeldet)
  * v5 - /admin/api.php mit ?auth=<Token>, Fallback wenn /api/auth 404 gibt

Beide Antwortformen werden auf PiholeStatus / PiholeDetails normalisiert, sodass das Frontend nur eine Struktur kennt. Die Abfrage laeuft bewusst ueber das Backend: Pi-hole setzt keine CORS-Header, und so bleibt das App-Passwort serverseitig. URL und Passwort liegen als Plugin-Settings in SQLite und werden von der REST-API nie zurueckgegeben - gemeldet wird nur, ob etwas hinterlegt ist.

Frontend:
  * Dashboard-Widget mit Blockrate-Gauge, Kennzahlen und Schnellsteuerung
  * eigene Pi-hole-Ansicht (Overlay-Menue) mit Verlaufschart und Top-Listen
  * Live-Updates per WebSocket (pihole:update), kein Polling im Browser

Steuerung: Blocking laesst sich fuer 30 s / 5 min / 1 h oder dauerhaft pausieren; die befristete Variante schaltet Pi-hole selbst zurueck. Als Automations- und Szenen-Aktion { type: 'pihole' } ebenfalls nutzbar.

Neue Endpunkte unter /api/pihole/*. Tests decken v6-Erkennung, v5-Fallback, die Normalisierung beider Generationen, das Schalten des Blockings sowie abgelehnte Passwoerter und nicht erreichbare Hosts ab. Dokumentation: docs/PIHOLE.md

author: eloy-leadtech
body:
La GUI del calco llevaba sin estilos desde el merge del #86. Una línea.

## Qué pasaba

`global.css` carga las 580 líneas de `pcf7-calco.css` (consola, tarjetas, tablas, botones, ficha, overlays) con un `@import`. Al reconstruir `global.css` durante los merges de hoy, esa línea acabó en la **3115** en vez de arriba del todo.

CSS solo respeta `@import` si precede a cualquier otra sentencia. Al no hacerlo, el navegador la ignora en silencio: el marcado PCF7 se pintaba, pero **sin su piel**.

Lo insidioso es que no rompe nada de lo que solemos mirar: TypeScript limpio, tests verdes, cero errores en consola del navegador. El único rastro era una advertencia en el log del servidor de Vite (`@import must precede all other statements`).

## El arreglo

Mover el `@import` a la línea 2. Eso es todo.

Más un **test que lo fija** (`ui/theme/global.css.test.ts`): comprueba que los dos `@import` están presentes y que ninguna regla los precede. Verificado por mutación — se movió la línea a propósito y el test falla; con el arreglo, pasa.

## Verificación

- `tsc --noEmit` limpio, **742 tests verdes** (740 + 2 nuevos).
- En el navegador: **75 reglas del calco aplicándose** (antes, ninguna de ese fichero). La consola de la plantilla recupera su degradado radial y sus bordes azules.

author: acosmi-fushihua
body:
## 这个 PR 做了什么

按 v3 §19.3 + §24 G0 全量落地 **Phase 0（Evidence Freeze）**：136 个新文件、9 份 parity ledger、1,641 条 entry，外加把判据做成能在本地跑红的闸门。另含一次工具链 delta audit（见下）。

仓库从「方案归档阶段，零实现代码」进入「Phase 0 产物齐备、G0 判据可机械核对」。

## 1. 10 crate workspace 骨架

§5.1 逐字十个：`contracts / domain / application / infra / agent / computer / server / ui / desktop / testkit`。每个 `lib.rs` 只写该 crate 的所有权边界（它负责什么、明确不负责什么），**零业务代码** —— 业务是 G1 的事。

`xtask` 刻意**不是**第 11 个 crate：§5.1 只给了四个建 crate 的理由，构建工具不占其一。它是 `openbot-testkit` 的 bin target，靠 `required-features` 隔离依赖，`cargo xtask` 由 `.cargo/config.toml` 的 alias 提供。这样「10 crate」这个 G1 判据保持逐字精确。

## 2. 9 份 parity ledger（1,641 条）

| ledger | 条数 | 构成 |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| `api` | 146 | 95 静态 handler + 9 模块挂载 + 2 中间件 + Better Auth 动态 + 4 条 CopilotKit facade + supervisor（5 路由 + 1 中间件）+ agent-computer 29 路径 |
| `routes` | 32 | 31 上游 route 文件（26 页 + 5 layout）+ memory 页（**新增**，§3.1 条 7） |
| `tables` | 53 | 28 表 + 13 migration + §4.3 的 12 张 native 新表 |
| `env` | 70 | 三个来源合并去重 |
| `events` | 73 | AG-UI 事件族 + audit 事件名 + §8.1 管线新增语义事件 |
| `components` | 22 | compiled gallery + sandboxed 运行时契约 |
| `browser-operations` | 46 | 29 上游路径 → §11.2 封闭 enum + file/shell + 输入 union |
| `ui` | 152 | 21 原语 + 45 组件 + 47 图标 + 6 运行时库 + 27 页 + 6 个新增原语 |
| `tests` | 1,047 | AST 级，见下 |

每条带 `owner` / `upstream` / 三值标签（`parity` / `新增` / `替代`）/ Rust 落点 / `test_id` / `migration_rule` / `status` / `evidence`。标签分布：parity 1,256 · 替代 347 · 新增 38。

## 3. `tests.yaml` 是真 AST 级，不是词法

v3 §1.3 明写「1,007 是词法命中，**不冒充** AST 解析后的精确 test 数」，而 §24 G8 要求 AST 级 mapping。

`xtask test-inventory` 用 `oxc_parser` + `oxc_ast_visit::Visit` 真解析上游 105 个 `.test.ts` / `.test.tsx`，得 **1,047** 个 `test` 节点、**229** 个 `describe` 节点，文件级三档分布 `ported 101` / `covered-by-golden 3` / `not-applicable-with-proof 1`。AST − 词法 = **+40**。

不起 Node/Bun 子进程：那会把闸门的正确性系在一个本仓刻意不安装的运行时上（§3.5 已裁决删 Bun launcher）。

## 4. 闸门：`cargo xtask parity-check`

强制 8 条规则（键完整性 · 三值标签 · owner 属十 crate · `status=done` **当且仅当**有 `done_evidence` · id 与 test_id 唯一 · test_id 格式 · `upstream` 禁裸行号 · recount 非空），45 条单测覆盖正负向。这是 §19.3 末句「CI 拒绝未归类项和没有证据的 `done`」的执行面。

`cargo xtask ci` = fmt → clippy → test → parity-check，本轮全绿。

## 5. 供应链（§16.3）

- `deny.toml` 四段 + build script **fail-closed** 白名单：11 份构建脚本逐字读过，体检结论就地记在配置里。负向对照实测：临时摘掉一条立刻判红，不是摆设。
- `provenance/sources.spdx.json`：49 个来源，含 §11.4 的 CrabCode 复用清单（`licenseConcluded: NOASSERTION` + 须逐文件书面授权）。
- `tools/pins.toml`：Tailwind 五平台 sha256 与 GitHub 官方 `sha256sums.txt` **逐个对上**，musl 两件按设计文档不收。

## 6. GUI 真源与真资产

`tokens.toml`（§4.2 二十行两套值）· `icons.toml` + **74** 个 Lucide 1.33.0 SVG（两向零漂移，`stroke-width` 改写 1.75）· Inter Variable 两份 woff2（**字节数与 sha256 与设计文档 §4.3 逐字符相等**）· `en`/`zh-CN` 各 238 键且键集合逐字相等 · `GLOSSARY.md` · `app.css` / `index.html` / `Trunk.toml`。

**零 Node**（D2 裁决）：本仓 `package.json` 与 `node_modules` 均为 0，正向对照 —— 同一条命令在上游有 10 处命中。

## 7. 工具链 delta audit：1.94.1 → 1.98.0

单独一个提交。旧 pin 站不住的三条实据：它是从 CrabCode 继承的默认值、v3 正文没写过任何理由；`1.98.0` 在 v3 定稿前三天就已发布；**而且它正在卡工具** —— `cargo build` 在 1.94.1 上直接拒绝 `oxc_parser@0.146.0 requires rustc 1.95.0`，Phase 0 被迫退到 `0.139.0`。

实跑回归后迁移影响恰好两处：一处新 clippy lint（`collapsible_match`，改 match guard，不放宽判据）；oxc 随之升 `0.146.0` 并连带 4 个新 build script 被白名单判红（逐字读过后放行）。**oxc 换版无行为差异**：两版产物剔除 parser 版本字段后逐字节相同。

## 验证（全部本轮实跑）

```
cargo fmt --all -- --check                                            PASS
cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings  PASS
cargo test --locked --workspace --all-features                        PASS
cargo xtask ci                                                        PASS (4/4)
cargo deny check                          advisories ok, bans ok, licenses ok, sources ok
cargo xtask parity-check                  9 ledger / entries=1641 / 0 违反
```

主控独立复核（不采信子代理自报）：

- v3 §28.4 的 14 条与设计文档 §17 的 16 条上游计数**逐个复现**，三条「零命中」断言均配正向对照
- 9 份 ledger 的 **143 条 recount 命令逐条真跑**，143/143 相符
- **防伪造核查**：1,603 条 `upstream` 引用逐条核实文件与符号存在 —— 抓出并修正 2 处编造的符号名（`createCopilotHandler` → `mountCopilotRuntime`、`snapshotPage` → `parseAriaSnapshot`）
- public 仓卫生：零私有仓名、零凭据、零 `CRABCODE_*`；两处 CrabCode 命中的粒度正好等于 v3 §11.4 已发布水平

## 已知的红与待裁决（不藏）

author: raveensr
body:
## Purpose
The [Register an AI Gateway](https://wso2.github.io/agent-manager/docs/v1.0.0-RC1/guides/register-ai-gateway/) page documents a console flow that no longer exists. `5ba390af2` ("Remove gateway creation functionality and related components", 2026-07-24) deleted `AddAIGateway.Organization.tsx`, `AddAIGatewayForm.tsx`, `CreateButtons.tsx`, the create hook and the form schema — so Step 2's "+ Add AI Gateway" button and "Create AI Gateway" form are gone. RC1 was cut on 2026-08-22, a month after that removal, so the published release docs walk readers to a button they cannot find.

The same removal invalidates the guidance on running an AI gateway **outside** the cluster: with no way to register a gateway, there is nothing to point an externally-hosted runtime at, and no way to give it the `EGRESS` role that guidance depends on.

## Goals
Stop documenting a flow the product no longer offers, in both the current docs and the release readers are on today, without leaving dangling links behind.

## Approach
Removes `guides/register-ai-gateway.mdx` and its sidebar entry, and removes both places the production guide describes outside-cluster AI gateways: the "External AI gateways" admonition in the hostnames section, and the paragraph closing "Gateway roles and topology".

Four pages listed "an AI Gateway registered and active" as a prerequisite and linked the deleted page. The prerequisite is still real — you do need an active gateway — so each now states where gateways come from (the installer registers one per environment) and links the [Gateway](../concepts/gateway.mdx) concept instead. The first-agent next-steps row is dropped rather than retargeted, because the "Register an LLM Service Provider" row directly beneath it already covers what a reader would have clicked through for.

Applied to `docs/` **and** `versioned_docs/version-v1.0.0-RC1/`, since RC1 is the version being read today. Older versions are deliberately untouched — they document a console that really did have the form when they were cut. Note `version-v1.0.0-beta` (cut 2026-08-12) is stale for the same reason; I left it out as a superseded pre-release, happy to include it if reviewers prefer.

**Two loose ends left for a product call, not a docs edit:**

1. `CP_GW_PUBLIC_HOST` is still exported, passed into the install as the gateway-mgmt hostname and the console's `gatewayControlPlaneUrl`, and listed in the endpoints table — but external gateways were its only documented purpose. If that endpoint no longer has a supported consumer, the install wiring should probably go too; that is a bigger change than this PR.
2. The console still ships `ViewGatewayGetStarted.tsx` — the Configure/Reconfigure panel that mints a registration token and renders Docker, VM and Kubernetes commands for an **existing** gateway. That flow is now undocumented. It either deserves a home in another page or should follow the create form out of the UI.

## User stories
As someone setting up Agent Manager, I don't want to be sent looking for a console button that was removed a release ago, or told to deploy a gateway topology the product can no longer register.

## Release note
Removed the "Register an AI Gateway" guide and the outside-cluster AI gateway guidance, which documented a console flow removed in an earlier release.

## Documentation
This PR *is* the documentation change. Pages removed: `guides/register-ai-gateway.mdx` (current and v1.0.0-RC1). Pages edited: `on-your-environment`, `environment-management`, `register-llm-service-provider`, `register-mcp-proxy`, `authorize-agent-access-to-mcp-tools`, `tutorials/create-your-first-agent`, plus both sidebars.

## Training
N/A — no product behaviour change. Worth noting for anyone maintaining training material that mentions registering a gateway from the console, since that flow is gone.

## Certification
N/A — documentation only. If a certification question covers registering an AI gateway from the console, it is testing removed functionality and should be retired separately.

## Marketing
N/A — documentation correction.

## Automation tests
- Unit tests
  > N/A — documentation only.
- Integration tests
  > `npm run build` in `documentation/` completes successfully. Docusaurus fails a build on broken links, so this is the check that matters for a page deletion with five inbound references; 386 documents processed. Two warnings are emitted, both pre-existing and unrelated (`docusaurus-plugin-llms-txt` failing to convert the `docs/` index route). `grep -r register-ai-gateway` over the current docs, RC1 docs and both sidebars returns nothing.

## Security checks
- Followed secure coding standards in http://wso2.com/technical-reports/wso2-secure-engineering-guidelines? yes
- Ran FindSecurityBugs plugin and verified report? N/A — documentation only, no code.
- Confirmed that this PR doesn't commit any keys, passwords, tokens, usernames, or other secrets? yes — content is removed, none added.

## Samples
N/A — no samples reference the removed page.

## Related PRs
None.

## Migrations (if applicable)
N/A. The deleted page's URL will 404 for anyone holding a bookmark; if that matters, a redirect to the [Gateway](https://wso2.github.io/agent-manager/docs/concepts/gateway) concept page can be added to the Docusaurus redirect config.

## Test environment
Docs site built locally on macOS with the repo's pinned Docusaurus toolchain (`npm ci && npm run build` in `documentation/`).

## Learning
Worth recording how this surfaced: while debugging an unrelated evaluation failure, the fail-closed behaviour of a monitor depended on whether a gateway could exist without an in-cluster `runtime_url`. That led to `validateGatewayRuntimeURL`, which only accepts cluster-local addresses, and from there to the fact that nothing outside the gateway chart's bootstrap job ever populates the field — which is only consistent with a product that no longer registers gateways living outside the cluster. The docs were the last place still saying otherwise.

author: estebanzimanyi
body:
A segment of a turning body carries the placements chosen by bisecting it while the rotation across a half exceeds a tolerance, stopping at a depth of five. Two consequences follow from the depth rather than from the geometry.

A half turn stops with the rotation across an interval still above the tolerance, so the answer follows the body least closely exactly where it turns most. And a quarter turn is carried by a power of two placements rather than by the number the tolerance asks for.

### The rule

The rotation says directly how many placements a segment needs: enough that no interval spans more than the tolerance, which is `ceil(rotation / tolerance) - 1` between the two the segment already has. This is what Chapter 4 states as `n = ceil(theta / theta_max) - 1`.

A rotation is read as the shortest way round, so it never exceeds pi, and an interval never asks for more than 62 placements at the tolerance this file carries. The count is bounded by the rule itself rather than by a cap.

### The conversion goes away

The recursion read a pose at each midpoint through `trgeometry_to_tpose`, which converts the whole temporal value, once per level: a quarter turn converted it about thirty times. The rotation of a segment is carried by the two instants themselves, so the conversion is not hoisted but removed.

### Measured

`154_trgeo_spatialrels` and `164_trgeo_spatialfuncs` both answer as they do on master, so a body is carried through the same regions while the placements are chosen by the rule rather than by a recursion depth. 35 lines replace 64.

author: kymuco
body:
## Summary

Finalize the browser-owned text runtime as the mature production baseline and freeze the standalone CWA SDK boundary for future transport implementations.

## Changes

- add Product Runtime Contract schema 1
- add machine-readable transport support tiers: PRODUCTION / EXPERIMENTAL
- keep transport support tier independent from capability state
- freeze browser-owned as the production transport baseline
- expose contract/support metadata through the primary Python SDK
- derive contract schema and transport tier in `ProductCapabilities` / `ProductRuntimeContract` while preserving the released `ProductRuntimeHealth` serialization
- preserve the minimal `ProductWriteTransport` protocol as the replaceable implementation boundary
- add fail-closed conformance tests for retry/fallback/finality/interface/operation-surface invariants and support-tier self-promotion
- add direct no-write conformance coverage for the real `BrowserOwnedProductTransport`
- add `docs/browser_owned_v1_contract.md`
- record the new public contract in `CHANGELOG.md` under Unreleased

## Review repairs

Final review found and repaired several contract-certification and compatibility gaps:

1. **Incremental finality was initially hard-coded rather than proven.**
   - `BrowserOwnedProductTransport.governance()` now explicitly declares `incremental_observation_is_canonical_finality=False`.
   - schema 1 requires that exact false value; missing or contradictory evidence fails closed.

2. **Support tier could initially be caller-supplied.**
   - `runtime_contract_schema` and `transport_support_tier` are now derived `init=False` capability metadata.
   - contract construction re-validates capability tier against the canonical CWA registry.
   - unknown/future transports remain `EXPERIMENTAL` until CWA explicitly graduates them.

3. **Missing fallback evidence could be interpreted as safe.**
   - raw write-transport governance must explicitly declare `fallback_transport=None` and `legacy_direct_write_fallback=False`.
   - missing or contradictory declarations fail closed before runtime normalization can mask them.

4. **The legacy-fallback proof could be validated but then discarded.**
   - `ProductRuntimeContract` now carries `legacy_direct_write_fallback` as a required frozen invariant.
   - direct construction validates it is exactly `False` and serialized contract output preserves it under `invariants`.

5. **Interface and operation metadata could overstate a partial runtime.**
   - runtime/governance/capability transport and product semantics must agree;
   - canonical/write interface identities are validated rather than defaulted;
   - every frozen schema-1 runtime operation must actually be callable.

6. **An intermediate change broadened the public `ProductWriteTransport` Protocol with arbitrary `**kwargs`.**
   - reverted during review to preserve the minimal released protocol and downstream structural-typing compatibility;
   - capability-gated concrete transport options remain implementation details below `ChatGPTProductRuntime`.

7. **Support metadata in `ProductRuntimeHealth` could contradict an injected transport's runtime identity.**
   - removed schema/tier authority from health entirely instead of changing the released `ChatGPTProductRuntime.health()` validation contract;
   - `ProductRuntimeHealth` is restored to the frozen 0.2 observational JSON shape;
   - support/schema authority exists only in cross-validated `ProductCapabilities` and `ProductRuntimeContract`.

8. **Fixture-only conformance was insufficient for the production baseline.**
   - added no-write tests that instantiate the real `BrowserOwnedProductTransport` and prove its governance plus `ChatGPTProductRuntime -> product_runtime_contract()` satisfy schema 1.

## Compatibility

This PR does not rewrite `ChatGPTProductRuntime`, browser-owned write execution, Temporary lifecycle, stream/finality algorithms, model-profile behavior, or Browser Authority behavior.

The released `ProductRuntimeHealth` constructor and JSON shape remain unchanged. The minimal `ProductWriteTransport` protocol remains unchanged. New support/contract authority is additive through `ProductCapabilities`, `ProductRuntimeContract`, and root production exports.

CWA remains a standalone SDK/CLI product. CMA and HDE remain downstream consumers of the same public contract.

## Validation

Final exact head:

`3718ba9962e7c0d37ab289b55865b720bce96f26`

GitHub Actions CI **#235: SUCCESS**.

```text
Ubuntu   Python 3.10-3.14   PASS
Windows  Python 3.10-3.14   PASS
full pytest suite            PASS (1312 passed on Ubuntu 3.10 reference job)
build wheel + sdist          PASS
package metadata validation  PASS
release artifact contract    PASS
installed wheel Ubuntu       PASS (Python 3.10 / 3.14)
installed wheel Windows      PASS (Python 3.10 / 3.14)
```

The only pytest warning is the pre-existing invalid-escape `DeprecationWarning` in `tests/test_payload_validation.py:117`; it is unrelated to PR9.0.

A new live product-write gate is not required for this PR because it changes no product-write algorithm, Temporary lifecycle, stream/finality algorithm, model selection behavior, or Browser Authority behavior. Existing live-validated browser-owned behavior remains the baseline; PR9.0 adds explicit contract metadata and fail-closed conformance enforcement around it.

## Review status

- all Codex P2 findings were repaired on subsequent exact heads
- final Codex review on `3718ba9962` reported: **“Didn't find any major issues.”**
- exact-head CI #235 is fully green
- authorized for merge on 2026-08-22

## Next milestones

PR9.1 remains the experimental alternative-transport milestone. PR9.2 covers images/files/multimodal. PR9.3 covers richer product observations.

author: jonil-botta
body:
## Summary

- treat full-width Win64 YMM values as call-volatile instead of assigning them to the low-half-only nonvolatile XMM6-XMM15 suffix
- reserve XMM/YMM/ZMM14 and 15 from allocator pools because legacy vector spill lowering owns those physical families as fixed temporaries
- remove the Windows-disabled and Linux-two-vector masked-preheader workarounds so both AVX2 targets share every unique loop invariant
- add focused ABI pool, call-crossing, and lowering-shape regressions

## Root causes

Win64 preserves only the low 128 bits of XMM6-XMM15. A private helper can therefore retain an XMM low half while `vzeroupper` destroys a live YMM upper half. Separately, spilled vector operations use YMM14/YMM15 (and their ZMM aliases) as implicit backend temporaries; the allocator previously assigned unrelated loop invariants to the same physical families.

## Validation

- `typelisp fmt` on all four changed files
- lint: 0 findings on all four changed files
- package tests: 344 passed, 0 failed in 72 files
- focused Windows AVX2 reproducers: private helper bool, word shifts, and Mandelbrot all exit 42 with unrestricted invariant hoisting
- focused Linux AVX2 varying enum payload reproducer exits 42 with six invariants
- complete `verify-spmd-simd.sh`: passed on Windows and Linux, including AVX2 and AVX-512
- complete `verify-ispc-mandelbrot.sh`: scalar/AVX2/AVX-512 passed on Windows and Linux
- bootstrap fixpoint: stage2.s == stage3.s (2,169,972 lines); embedded-provenance parity passed

## Generated code

Linux Mandelbrot AVX2, fixed versus the bounded base:

- static kernel instructions: 725 -> 719
- static kernel bytes: 3,711 -> 3,703
- Callgrind instructions for the correctness workload: 32,493 -> 32,103 (-1.2%)

Fixes #6761
